definitions.explanation: A member of Japan's Self-Defense Forces ({自衛隊|じえいたい}) — the term used in place of 'soldier' for Japan's uniformed personnel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自衛官|じえいかん}だ。
examples.english: My older brother is an SDF member.

examples.japanese: {自衛官|じえいかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: SDF personnel carried out rescue operations in the disaster area.

examples.japanese: {自衛官|じえいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{採用|さいよう}{試験|しけん}→採用試験：29861_saiyoushiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: To become an SDF member, you must pass the recruitment examination.

notes:
A member of the ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧ (Japan Self-Defense Forces). Because Japan's constitution renounces war, members are called {自衛官|じえいかん} rather than ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧ (soldier).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自衛官|じえいかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an SDF member
- ⟦{現役|げんえき}→現役：21782_geneki⟧{自衛官|じえいかん}: an active-duty SDF member

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧: the Self-Defense Forces (the organization itself)
- ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧: soldier — the general word, avoided for Japan's own forces
